question: What siRNA dose did Gao et al. use in their study?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE text ILIKE '%Gao%' OR text ILIKE '%dose%' OR text ILIKE '%mg/kg%' OR text ILIKE '%nmol%' OR text ILIKE '%μg%' ORDER BY page, line_no
SELECT id, text FROM cells WHERE text ILIKE '%Gao%' OR (text ILIKE '%FOXM1%') OR text ILIKE '%CL4H6%' OR text ILIKE '%[55]%' OR text ILIKE '%55%' ORDER BY id
SELECT id, page, line_no, text FROM lines WHERE page IN (6,7) AND (text ILIKE '%FOXM1%' OR text ILIKE '%CL4H6%' OR text ILIKE '%LNP%' OR text ILIKE '%ionizable%') ORDER BY page, line_no
SELECT id, page, line_no, text FROM lines WHERE page=6 AND line_no BETWEEN 1 AND 12 ORDER BY line_no
SELECT id, row_no, col_no, text FROM cells WHERE table_id='p6.T2' AND row_no IN (4,5,6) ORDER BY row_no, col_no
SELECT id, statement, printed_text FROM figure_facts WHERE statement ILIKE '%Gao%' OR statement ILIKE '%FOXM1%' OR statement ILIKE '%dose%' OR printed_text ILIKE '%dose%' OR statement ILIKE '%mg/kg%'
SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE text ILIKE '%mg kg%' OR text ILIKE '%mg/kg%' OR text ILIKE '%nM%' OR text ILIKE '%siRNA dose%' OR text ILIKE '%concentration%' ORDER BY page, line_no
